# CardSense: Sports Card Scanner

> CardSense is a free iPhone app that identifies any sports card from a photo and shows its estimated market value based on recent eBay sales. It supports baseball, basketball, football, hockey, and soccer cards, and includes collection management with automatic value tracking.

Key facts:
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757801294
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 18.2+), free download with optional premium upgrade
- Identification: AI trained on 5,000+ card types from Topps, Panini, Upper Deck, and more; recognizes rookies, inserts, parallels, autographs, and memorabilia cards; detects variants, serial numbers, and condition grades
- Pricing data: estimated values from recent eBay sales with average, median, price range, sales velocity, and price history charts
- Collection: unlimited saved cards, custom folders, notes, search, automatic total collection value
- Android: no Google Play listing (404)
